title: Print two words
instruction: Print **Hello Python** with a single `print()` and two arguments.
test_suite:
import io, sys

def test_prints_hello_python():
    _old = sys.stdout
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = _old
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert output == 'Hello Python\n', f"Expected Hello Python, got {output!r}"

import io, sys, re

def test_prints_two_words():

    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = _old
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert re.match('.+ .+\n', output), f"Output should have two words, got {output!r}"

title: Mix text and a number
test_suite:
import io, sys, re

def test_prints_age_format():
    _old = sys.stdout
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = _old
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert re.match('I am \\d+ years old\n', output), f"Expected I am N years old, got {output!r}"
